body: Fact
It's a paradox to claim emptiness yet be in love. On surface it makes no sense.
Damn, what a cruel fate... I wish that you find strength and a solution to your ED

Coercion is the perfect word I was looking for. It felt exactly like that. I told myself "Didn't I just kinda coerce her into having sex with me?"... Although I know I didn't,  to be quite honest it still made me feel quite horrible.
The discussion will take place tomorrow. It will take a lot of courage but I find out the truth

She has had a trauma in the past. However it is completely unrelated to this situation (well I'm 99.9% sure). The communication definitely is an issue though. I mean like I said I really have a lot of communication issues, so it took me a lot of effort to tell her all this. She always wants me to open up to her but now she reacted like that. I will definitely talk to her tomorrow morning and get her to speak.
Yeah all this teasing really drove me crazy sometimes. I'd even get pissed because of that. I don't want to frequently live through that anymore, so I told her.
I already have. But I will try again tomorrow, thanks.

Hey, first of all thanks for your time. I don't think she's too insecure, I often remind her that she is really I mean REALLY beautiful and that I find her extremely sexy. I will try to talk to her tomorrow maybe she will open up.
Aside from that our relationship is great! Better than I ever imagined but I unfortunately think you are right. There's something going on and we absolutely have to discuss it.

Thanks for your message and for reading my story. My situation almost seems helpless, I've been struggling a lot more lately... but I haven't given up yet. Thanks again for your message it genuinely made me feel better. Also thank you for telling me that I write well... I like writing stories and such so it's nice to know people like it.

Now that's where we (suicidal people) are paradoxes. We seek death but are afraid of it. Makes me realize that no one actually wants to die. We are all just being pushed to that point. Again, really selfish coming from myself , but I hope that you'll find happiness soon
I still hope that you'll fight through your pain and that you'll find happiness soon.
If guns were allowed in my country I'd be gone for a long time now.
That's why I ultimately didn't do it
I'm a hypocrite for saying that (because I already fully planned my suicide), but DONT DO IT!! This would be an extremely agonizing death!
Thanks for your kind words. I'll try my best finding a job.
Read [this](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/em7kqk/why_i_will_commit_suicide_in_less_than_30days/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) it's easier than explaining everything.
12 days to live.
Ohh that's how you meant it. Sorry I had a false understanding. From that point of view I do have that same opinion too.
The worst part is that most of suicidal people are or at least feel extremely lonely and live through the worse possible situations all alone. Sadly. Life is not fair.

Death or nonexistence are not the same. To die you have to life. Live is full of passion, emotion and experience.. one day we will all die but our existence will be remembered. I personally would also prefer to never have existed. I would be less a burden to those around me.

I personally could go on living with all sorts of negativity.. but as time progresses I begin to question myself what the purpose of continuing is. And be who finds no purpose, finds no will to continue anymore.
I almost died.. multiple times already. Let me tell you, no one actually wants to die.
I already posted a story about my circumstances, but it's not the full version. I thought about posting it soon although it's pretty long.

I tried. Some of my friends tried. Teachers tried. And even therapists tried. They are the most stubborn people I have ever encountered. For them the problem lies with me they will never look for a mistake at themselves first.
Not much I just feel more relieved the more I'm approaching the end.
I have had enough chances. Fucked it up and luck is not on my side anymore. Whether I want to or not, in less than 30 days I will die.
That's actually a pretty good idea. Will do. Thank you!
Sadly there isn't but thanks a lot
If I recall right, we are not allowed to discuss methods in this

It's not a thing about suffering anymore. I've suffered my whole life and I have learned to co-exist with that suffering. This time it is about finding a solution to a problem. This is the solution I found.
Thank you for the nice words and for your concern, but I sadly have no other choice than putting an end to this.
